payload.summary: Two ward docs send a session onto branches without saying whether those branches are still live
payload.detail: docs/ward-flow-coordination-rules.md and docs/ward-flow-fold-manifest-2026-08-31.md instruct a session onto claude/Wardquestions and claude/Ward-design with no status marker, flagged by tests/stale-resume-instructions.test.ts. Both branches are currently UNMERGED (merge-base --is-ancestor exit 1), so the correct marker says they are live, not merged. claude/Wardquestions holds the orchestrator handover and ten ward documents that exist on no other branch, so marking it merged would be worse than the present silence. Measured at fb17db7b1.
